source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Enable Persistence-Mode via cmd: nvidia-smi -pm 1
2. Run PCIe-Test via cmd: dcgmi diag -v -r pcie
3. Disable Persistence-Mode via cmd: nvidia-smi -pm 0

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. The result of PCIe-Test should be PASS without errors.

original_test_intent: Run the approved DCGM PCIe diagnostic on every target GPU, verify the full tool result against the expected PCIe topology/link policy without unresolved events, and preserve/restore persistence state.
original_method: Validate DCGM syntax, stable GPU/BDF/slot/upstream topology and link baseline, execute source persistence enable plus verbose PCIe diagnostic under one approved plan, retain full link/event evidence, then restore approved persistence state.
manual_activity: One authorized user approves the unchanged PCIe diagnostic/restoration plan. All commands, topology reads and evidence capture are machine-executable; no physical setup is inherent.
required_inputs: Approved DCGM/dcgmi, driver and GPU UUID/DCGM-ID/BDF/slot map
Expected endpoint/upstream generation/width/topology and acceptable link-event policy
Installed-tool proof for `-v -r pcie` or version-equivalent syntax
Workload/traffic window and persistence baseline/final state
safety_requirements: Verify exact target topology and separate management/recovery before state change or diagnostic.
Do not run on active protected workloads/traffic without the approved window.
One approval covers only the fixed plan; stop on syntax/target deviation, link degradation, driver error or device loss.
Preserve full diagnostic, lspci/link and kernel/BMC evidence; no automatic GPU reset, PCIe retrain, service restart or retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect tool/GPU/BDF/topology/link/workload/persistence baseline and verify syntax/plan gates.
Execute persistence enable and the complete verbose source PCIe diagnostic.
Compare diagnostic/link/event evidence to the approved policy, restore final state and report Tool Result.
engineer_actions: Approve tools/syntax, target topology, link policy, window, state changes and recovery.
Resolve degraded link or diagnostic/platform discrepancy.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `--pcie` may be version-specific but is not proven equivalent to source `-v -r pcie`; it also omits persistence and topology coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve source syntax and surrounding state steps; use an alternate only with installed-version documentation proving equivalent PCIe diagnostic/verbosity.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Both persistence transitions, verbose pcie run, criterion, script URL and 2/2-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: SOURCE PCIE DIAGNOSTIC RETAINED WITH TOPOLOGY CORRELATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute a stable per-GPU/DCGM-ID transaction and correlate full diagnostic results with endpoint/upstream `lspci` link state plus kernel/BMC events and final restoration.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: DCGM-supported NVIDIA GPUs and their approved PCIe topology.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record DCGM/dcgmi, driver, GPU firmware, pciutils, BIOS, OS/kernel and BMC.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: NVIDIA DCGM diagnostics documentation for the deployed release, pciutils evidence and referenced project script.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact syntax proof, stable topology, link policy, workload and restoration controls without replacing the PCIe test.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A DCGM PCIe PASS may not cover all platform-specific bandwidth/retrain expectations; those differences must remain explicit.

project_override_considerations: Projects may approve version-equivalent syntax, target scope and link expectations. Actual GPUs/links and coverage differences must be reported; reduced scope is not full master coverage.
expected_evidence: DCGM/driver/pciutils versions and stable GPU/DCGM/BDF/slot/upstream topology
Baseline link capability/state, workload/traffic and persistence approval
Full verbose PCIe diagnostic output/return code and exact resolved command
Post link/AER/kernel/BMC evidence and approved persistence restoration
